name: Engelke Farm
tagline: Engelke Farm: Family Fun in Troy, New York
description: Engelke Farm is a pumpkin patch in Troy, NY. Visitors come for Strawberries, Blackberries, Pumpkins, Corn, and Tomatoes, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
